decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted, including its colour, pointing/bonding shall match those used on the external surfaces of existing building.

No window(s) and/or door(s) other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The ground floor side windows serving Flats 1 and 2 (south-west facing) in the side elevation of the property shall: (a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form in perpetuity.

Prior to the first occupation, the development shall be carried out in complete accordance with the submitted Fire Safety -Proposed Ground, First & Loft Floor Plan entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3.1-FS-352 and Reasonable Exception Statement received March 3rd, 2025, submitted as part this application and the declarations made that the development shall accord with Building Regulations standards and Approved Document B (Fire Safety) Volume 1 – Dwellinghouses to be operated in accordance with and retained in perpetuity.

The development hereby permitted shall not be first occupied until the proposed secure cycle parking stores have been installed and made lockable, in accordance with the approved details.  The cycle stores shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity.

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be first occupied until details of the proposed boundary treatment for the front, side and rear gardens; including details of their materials, appearance, height and colouring have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. This shall also include details on the access gates. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved plans prior to the first occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity.

Prior to the first occupation of the development, evidence of Secured by Design Certification shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed, or justification shall be submitted where the accreditation requirements cannot be met. Secure by design measures shall be implemented the development shall be retained in accordance with the approved details.

<p>Notwithstanding the details submitted and the annotations made on “Proposed Ground Floor Plan” entitled “Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3-00-302”, the development proposals, hereby permitted are for 2.No studio’s, housing no more than&nbsp;<span lang="EN-US" style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -21.25pt;">one
person occupancy each and 1.No two-bedroom self-contained unit, housing no more
than four persons occupancy only.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:12.5pt;margin-bottom:
0cm;margin-left:41.05pt;margin-bottom:.0001pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:
-21.25pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><span lang="EN-US" style=""><o:p></o:p></span></p><p>The development hereby permitted shall be used solely for Planning Use Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.&nbsp; &nbsp;</p>

The development hereby permitted shall not be first occupied until the refuse stores have been installed in accordance with the approved details and they shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity. The refuse (recycling and waste) bins shall be stored at all times in the location indicated on the approved plans, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage areas.

<p>Prior to the first occupation, a revised scheme of hard and soft landscaping works with the provision of enhanced soft landscaping to the front forecourt, in particular a wide strip of planting surrounding the perimeter of the ground floor front bay windows serving Flat 1.&nbsp;</p><ol><li>Soft landscaping work shall include planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers/densities, written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken, and a landscape implementation programme.&nbsp;</li><li>Hard landscaping works which shall include: material details, if permeable materials are used full construction details of permeable paving and their maintenance plan. If non permeable material is used, details regarding management of surface water run-off from the proposed hard standing. The approved hard landscaping details shall be installed prior to first occupation in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity.</li></ol>
description: Conversion of dwelling into three flats (1 X 2 Bed & 2 X Studios); single storey side and rear extension; first floor rear extension; rear dormer; installation of two rooflights in front roofslope; separate amenity space; bin and cycle stores
